read.en: Rockwell Automation fell 0.5% on Nov 12 to $404.20, trading $401.76–412.00. It is above the 5-day ($394.6) and below the 10-day ($412.0), 200-day ($426.7), 30-day ($427.7) and 100-day ($441.4), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($440.27), and RSI is 42.9.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月12日下跌 0.5%，收于 $404.20，盘中区间 $401.76–412.00。股价位于 5 日均线（$394.6）上方，10 日（$412.0）、200 日（$426.7）、30 日（$427.7）和 100 日均线（$441.4）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$440.27），RSI 为 42.9。

read.en: No level changed: the $412 high stalled at the 10-day again; $397.5–401.8 held. Resistance is $406.9–415 (Sep 17 and Oct 15 lows, 10-day), then $426.7–427.7 (200 and 30-day) and $440.3 (SAR). Support is $397.5–401.8 (Nov 10 high, Nov 11–12 lows), then $392.5–394.6 (5-day, Nov 6 and 9 highs) and $383.1–388.4. A close above $415 would target $427; below $397.5, $392.5–394.6.
